title: Canonical linear evaluation of internal Hom on stalks
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ module sheaves. Internal Hom is [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and the module stalks are [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] with their functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every $x\in X$ there is an $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map $c:\mathcal Hom(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x,\mathcal G_x)$ such that for any opens $x\in V\subseteq U$, local morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal G|_U$ and section $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, $c(\varphi_x)(s_x)=(\varphi_V(s))_x$. No finiteness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP on 2026-10-13

proof.text: On common smaller neighborhoods, naturality of a local morphism identifies the restriction of its evaluation with the evaluation of the restricted section.

If two local morphisms represent the same germ and two argument sections represent the same germ, shrink separately to witness these equalities, then intersect the two neighborhoods. The preceding restriction identity identifies the two output germs. Hence evaluation defines a function of the two germs.

Represent three additive arguments on one neighborhood, using exists_le_germ_eq twice. For a scalar and two arguments, first represent the scalar and then shrink twice. Sectionwise evaluation preserves addition in both arguments and scalar multiplication in both arguments, using homObjEvalId for scalar linearity in the morphism. The germ_smul formula transports these identities to stalks. Bundle this bilinear evaluation as the required linear map.

lean.statement: theorem exists_stalk_internalHom_linearMap : ∃ c : (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj (F.homObj G) →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj G), ∀ (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (φ : (F.homObj G).val.obj (op U)) (V : Opens X) (i : V ⟶ U) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : F.val.obj (op V)), c (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (F.homObj G).val.presheaf U x hxU φ) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V x hxV s) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf V x hxV (φ.app (op (Over.mk i)) s)
